seoTitle: Car Finance Calculator With Balloon Payment
metaDescription: Calculate monthly car loan payments with a deposit and a final balloon payment, plus total interest and total cost. Free and private.
intro: Monthly instalment, interest and total cost for a car loan that ends with a balloon payment.
why:
A balloon payment lowers the monthly instalment because part of the loan is left to the end. That balance still accrues interest all along, so total interest is higher than for a loan paid down fully.

Use the tool to compare a plain loan (balloon 0) with a balloon deal on the same price and rate. Remember you must pay, refinance or return the car at the end, depending on the contract.
howTo: Enter car price, deposit, rate and term in months.
Enter the balloon amount, or 0 for a normal loan.
Compare the monthly payment and total cost.

faq.q: Is the balloon included in total cost?
faq.a: Yes. Total paid to the lender includes all instalments and the balloon.
No. Arrangement fees, insurance and taxes are not part of the calculation.

faq.q: What if I cannot pay the balloon?
faq.a: That depends on the contract: refinance, sell the car or hand it back. Read the terms before signing.
